One of Zao's Tibia Tales. The old {npc:Cranky Lizard Crone}, in the Souleater Mountains, asks you to find the last three wills of her family, lost in the ruined houses of the village. When you hand them over you discover the truth about her. You receive 50 experience points for each level you have and can obtain the addons of the {wiki:Wayfarer Outfits|Wayfarer Outfits}.
An old lizard needs help to carry out her family's last wishes. Or does she?
No minimum level, but the recommended level is **130+**.
Enough potions: the mountains are full of monsters and it is easy to get cornered
{spell:Levitate} (or parcels/crates) for the mountain pass between Farmine and the Zao Steppe
**50 experience points for each level** you have
Being able to get the addons of the {wiki:Wayfarer Outfits|Wayfarer Outfits}
When you hand the three {item:Faded Last Will|Faded Last Wills} to the {npc:Cranky Lizard Crone}.
The Souleater Mountains have lots of monsters: do not get cornered and, if needed, run to the crates instead of killing everything.
Creatures brought by other players may show up: high-class lizards, {creature:Lancer Beetle|Lancer Beetles}, {creature:Wailing Widow|Wailing Widows} and {creature:Brimstone Bug|Brimstone Bugs}.
The quest appears in the Quest Log under **Tibia Tales**.
1. Getting to the Cranky Lizard Crone

Take the {wiki:Steamship} to **Farmine**: {npc:Brodrosch} (far below Kazordoon) or {npc:Gurbasch} (8 floors below Cormaya), with {key:hi}, {key:farmine} and {key:yes}. In Farmine, go **east** of {npc:Ongulf}, pass the sealed doors, stand on the switch and use the **right lever**: the elevator takes you to the surface of the mountain. Follow the passage **east**, going down the mountain with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/crates), until you come out in the Zao Steppe. From there go to {wiki:Northern Zao|Northern Zao} via the route of the {wiki:Wrath of the Emperor Quest|Wrath of the Emperor Quest}: through the Lion's Den (mission 1) or, after mission 2, through the reactivated link to the rebel hideout ({wiki:Zao Rebel Camp|Zao Rebel Camp}), beneath the Souleater Mountains.
Exit of the mountain passage (entrance to the Zao Steppe)

Coming from the **west** or the **east**, go to the stairs that lead up to the {wiki:Souleater Mountains|Souleater Mountains}, near the {wiki:Zao Rebel Camp|Zao Rebel Camp}. On the way you may meet all kinds of monsters.
Route to the Souleater Mountains stairs
Head **southwest**, careful not to get cornered. There you find the {npc:Cranky Lizard Crone} (blue circle on the map).
Blue circle = Cranky Lizard Crone; follow the arrow to go up

There are {creature:Souleater|Souleaters}, {creature:Mutated Rat|Mutated Rats}, {creature:Mutated Bat|Mutated Bats}, {creature:Mutated Tiger|Mutated Tigers} and {creature:Death Blob|Death Blobs} all over the mountain.
Say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. She wants you to find three {item:Faded Last Will|Faded Last Wills} hidden in the houses around.
Follow the arrow on the map and go up the stairs. The first {item:Faded Last Will} is in a {item:Box (Brown Quest)} up there, near the ramp (blue circle).
Head **south** until you reach some stairs. Go up, kill or run from all the monsters and pick up the second {item:Faded Last Will} from a {item:Box (Quest)} (blue circle).
Blue circles = boxes of the first and second wills

Go back down the stairs. Walk a few steps **south** to another ramp and go down. Again, kill or run from the monsters and pick up the third {item:Faded Last Will} from a {item:Chest (Quest)|chest} (blue circle).
Blue circle = chest of the third will
Talking to the Cranky Lizard Crone again

With the three {item:Faded Last Will|Faded Last Wills}, go back to the {npc:Cranky Lizard Crone} and say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. She reveals that she was the one who killed the family and that she is actually stuck there as punishment. You receive the experience and can now get the addons of the {wiki:Wayfarer Outfits|Wayfarer Outfits}.
50 experience per level + access to the Wayfarer Outfits addons

Come down from the Souleater Mountains the same way to the Rebel Camp. In {npc:Chartan}'s room, the blue flame **south** of him takes you to the {wiki:Muggy Plains} (available after mission 2 of the Wrath of the Emperor Quest); from there go back to the Zao Steppe by teleport and head **southwest** to the mountain pass. Climb it with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/crates) and go **west** to the Farmine elevator. On the Steamship, {npc:Thorgrin} takes you to Kazordoon or Cormaya ({key:hi}, the destination, {key:yes}).
This quest is part of the {wiki:Tibia Tales|Tibia Tales}.
